news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.7% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.48 (vs ₹0.05 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.48 (up from ₹0.05 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹16.6m (up 23% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹2.25m (up ₹2.00m from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 14% (up from 1.9% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 80% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 9% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.

news.title: KJMC Financial Services Limited Announces Executive Changes
news.body: KJMC Financial Services Limited at its board meeting held on February 13, 2026, approved resignation of Mrs. Khushbu Bohra from the post of Company Secretary and Compliance Officer with immediate effect from the closure of business hours of February 13, 2026 due to personal reasons and is hereby relieved from the said position. Appointment of Mr. Omkar Raghunath Bamne as Company Secretary & Compliance Officer of the Company with effect from February 16, 2025, under Section 203 of the Companies Act, 2013 and under Regulation 6 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 read with Regulation 9(3) of SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015.
